name: Osmious-Corrie
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, tectonic rift valleys emerge like the bones of the planet.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Leviathan fauna breach the sea-mist at dusk, singing on frequencies felt in the teeth.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
